notes.title: Get our newest game, One Line Coloring with 15% release discount!
notes.notes:
Hello Trancelation fans!

We are excited and happy to share our newest game with you. It is a new approach to a well-established idea of drawing shapes - only this time, updated with beautiful 3D models, that come to life as collectibles. It is your task to complete charming dioramas. 

We also prepared a new release trailer so jump in and enjoy the colorful world of One Line Coloring!

[previewyoutube=aFkp1hXyRsY;full][/previewyoutube]

We also would like to thank you for ongoing support and hope you will like our newest addition to the relaxing puzzles family!

MythicOwl Team
